note: Five final opaque PNGs; use CSS screen blending and opacity for a translucent appearance over the existing blue-violet theme. Discarded transparency experiments are not part of this selection.

variants.name: 01-violet-circuit
variants.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied square image, which shows a very sparse central vertical arrangement of irregular architectural LED dot-matrix panels in violet, cyan, pale blue, magenta and a tiny warm accent on a nearly black background. Preserve the exact silhouette, placement, spacing, perspective, scale and recognizable arrangement of ALL existing dot panels; keep their dots fine and restrained. Do not replace them with solid shapes. Primary request: add only a few elegant abstract PCB / circuit-board-like conductive trace structures in the EMPTY areas between and around the existing panels. This is a FINAL BACKGROUND ART ASSET for a dark Art-Net controller web interface, not a UI screenshot. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no UI cards, no mockup frame, no watermark. Square composition matching the source. Premium minimal design, understated neon, subtle glossy highlights and gentle shimmer, extremely fine precise traces, a handful of tiny via dots, very low visual density. Preserve generous negative space and darkness for legible UI overlays. No literal circuit board, no chips, no heavy grid, no bright broad streaks, no haze covering the dots, no lens flares, no busy sci-fi HUD. Base interface palette: near-black navy #0b0d19, blue #5f84f7, lavender #a89bf8, restrained cyan accents.
Variant 1 — VIOLET CIRCUIT: add about six delicate short angular PCB trace paths with 45-degree corners and a few rounded terminals, mostly in the gaps to the left and right of the dot panels. Blue-violet hairlines with a very faint lavender luminous rim, tiny polished pin-point glints. Remain almost black away from the marks. Opaque near-black navy background with an almost imperceptible violet gradient. This is the most restrained, clean technical variant.

variants.name: 05-ghost-circuit
variants.prompt: Edit the supplied original LED-dot image into an extremely minimal Art-Net web-interface background. Keep the original panel shapes, exact positions, tiny separated colored LED points, perspective and scale. Add just four short, ghost-thin abstract PCB traces in unused black space: pale periwinkle and smoky blue, two tiny cyan endpoint glints, softly rounded 45-degree corners. Use understated polished-glass glints without any glass panels. The traces should be barely visible, restrained and delicate. Pure nearly black background (#02030a), no checkerboard, no transparency visualization, no colored filled surfaces behind the dots, no haze, no lens flares, no text or UI. Darkest and quietest of a five-variant set, suitable to blend with screen at low opacity over a navy/violet gradient. Square framing, ample empty space.
